title: Precision Metal Casting Solutions -  Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
snippet: Precision Metal Casting Solutions - Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) Skip to main content Skip to navigation # Frequently Asked Questions ## Frequently Asked Questions – Precision Investment Casting ### Q1: What materials can you cast? We offer a wide range of materials, including: Stainless steel: SUS304, SUS316, SUS410/CA15 Carbon steel: S25C, S45C Aluminum alloys: ADC12, AC4C/A356 Copper alloys and special tool steels (available upon request) ### Q2: What is your casting process? We specialize in lost wax investment casting using the silica sol method, which allows for fine surface finishes, tight tolerances, and stable mechanical performance. Vacuum-assisted casting is available for thin-wall and high-precision parts. ### Q3: What tolerances can you achieve? Typical dimensional tolerances fall within CT5–CT6 standard, or approximately ±0.05 mm to ±0.1 mm, depending on geometry and size. ### Q4: What is your production weight and size range? We can produce castings ranging from approximately 10 grams up to 80 kilograms, with various shapes and wall thicknesses down to 2.0mm. ### Q5: Do you provide machining and surface finishing? Yes. We offer Conventional / CNC machining, vibratory finishing, shot blasting, and custom jigs & fixtures for secondary operations. Heat treatment and other finishing processes are available through our qualified partners. ### Q6: Do you manufacture tooling in-house? Yes. We design and fabricate aluminum and steel molds in-house to ensure full control over quality, precision, and lead time. ### Q7: What is your typical lead time? Tooling & sampling: 25 ~ 45 working days. Production orders: 45 ~ 60 working days depending on volume and process. Rush orders may be accommodated upon request. ### Q8: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)? We offer flexible MOQs to support new product development. Small batches starting from 50 pieces are acceptable, depending on part size and complexity. ### Q9: What quality control processes do you follow? All parts are thoroughly inspected using: Spectrometer for material composition CMM and gauges for dimensional accuracy after machining. Visual and surface inspection for defects Inspection reports and material certificates are provided upon request. ### Q10: Do you ship internationally? Yes. We regularly ship parts to Singapore, Indonesia, Japan, and other global markets via air or sea freight. We support EXW, FOB, and DDP shipping terms. ### Q11: Do you sign NDAs or handle confidential projects? Absolutely. We welcome NDA agreements and treat all client data, drawings, and communications with strict confidentiality. ### Q12: What are your payment terms? Tooling fees are typically 100% prepaid Production terms are flexible and can be discussed case by case ### 👉 Still have questions? Feel free to Contact Us — our technical and sales team will respond within 24 hours. ### @Copyright 2026 Cordial Resources Enterprise (AS0458660-P） | Precision Casting & Manufacturing Solutions in Malaysia Page updated Google Sites Report abuse

My name is CK Toh. When you talk to me, you’re not dealing with an outsourced sales rep—you’re working with someone who is part of the manufacturing operation. I represent the foundry directly. You can think of me as your internal contact—fully aligned with the factory, both technically and strategically. I understand what you need, and I know how to make it happen. ### 🔧 The Reality of Manufacturing in Malaysia Let’s be honest: Malaysia’s casting supply chain is still developing. Most foundries focus only on casting raw parts (blanks). If you need heat treatment, precision machining, surface finishing, or even non-destructive testing (NDT), you’re often on your own to find suppliers, coordinate schedules, and manage risks. This often leads to: * Miscommunication between suppliers * Delayed timelines * Higher costs due to fragmented logistics * Stress and time wasted on follow-ups ### 🚀 We Offer a One-Stop Manufacturing Solution ### Cordial Resources Enterprise offers a one-stop solution by partnering with ISO-certified ✅ local manufacturers. We oversee the entire production process—from design to final delivery. 1. Submit your drawing or sample 2. We analyze, quote, and plan production 3. We coordinate all secondary processes – machining, heat treatment, surface finishing, and NDT 4. You receive weekly progress updates 5. We arrange delivery to port or factory With us, you only need to focus on your requirements—we’ll handle the rest. ### 🧩 In Short: We don’t just manufacture. We solve problems.
